entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this useless VeloBand I bought. This is taking forever and I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is VF77819. Just process the return. I don't have time for a runaround.

Thank you, Mark. I have your account here. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 19 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter! I don't want it. It's not what I expected. The website says 90 days, so just give me the return label!

I understand your frustration, sir. However, I have to explain our updated return **policy** for wearable sensors. For newer devices that are worn on the skin, due to **hygiene** and **sanitation** regulations, we had to change the window. After 10 days, it's simply **too late** to accept it back.
WHAT?! Are you kidding me? Ten days?! That is an absolute scam! I'm looking at your website right now and it says 90! This is bait-and-switch! I want to speak to your manager, right now!

Sir, please let me just double-check the specific model number on your order... one moment... Ah. My apologies. You are absolutely correct. I was referencing the policy for our new VeloBand Pulse, which has the stricter guidelines.
You're damn right I'm correct! You people don't even know your own products. So are you going to process my return or do I need to file a complaint and light you up on social media?

No, that won't be necessary, and I sincerely apologize for my error. Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you received it 19 days ago, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I can process this for you immediately.
Finally. Okay, fine. Just send me the label.

Of course. I have just initiated the return. The pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Again, my apologies for the confusion, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
